title: Get Sleek Hair with One or Three Brazilian Blowouts and Washes at Hector Salon #2 (Up to 59% Off)
description:
Looking for smooth, frizz-free? A Brazilian blowout Treatment could be just what you need! Imagine waking up every day with sleek, manageable hair without the fuss. Plus, it's valid with any stylist at the salon!
What We Offer
One or Three Brazilian Blowouts and Washes
Please see the below image for estimated lengths of short, medium, and long hair. 
Why You Should Grab The Offer



At Hector's Salon #2, owner Rosy Mendoza, with over 20 years of styling expertise, leads an international team of master stylists and color technicians dedicated to enhancing hair and beautifying appearances. This Redken salon invites clients to experience luxury in plush styling chairs, where precision and bespoke styling, and botanical treatments transform their look. Hector's Salon #2 uses premium products from Paul Mitchell, Matrix, Redken, Kadus, and Marrakesh aiming to offer top-notch results and client satisfaction.

faqs.question: Where is Hector's Beauty Salon Inc located?
faqs.answer: Hector's Beauty Salon Inc is located at 6740 Laurel Canyon Boulevard in North Hollywood, Los Angeles, CA 91606.

faqs.question: What type of hair service is included in the Tame Your Frizz with One or Three Brazilian Blowouts and Washes deal?
faqs.answer: The deal includes Brazilian Blowout and Wash services, which fall under the hair straightening and hair styling categories.

faqs.question: Is the Tame Your Frizz with One or Three Brazilian Blowouts and Washes deal suited for ongoing hair care?
faqs.answer: The deal offers a three-session option, which allows customers to receive multiple Brazilian Blowouts and Washes over time at Hector's Beauty Salon Inc.

I love it!

review_samples.author: Corina
review_samples.text: Janet did a great Job on my hair,  will always go back to Hectors Beauty Salon only . I have only had good experiences there ❤️

review_samples.author: Charlene
review_samples.text: Nice staff, good value.  They wouldn't let me book an appointment for only a haircut, just show up and wait.

review_samples.author: Guest
review_samples.text: I am really happy with how my hair turned out! They took their time to ensure a smooth detailed process. However, I didn’t run into some communication issues so it was difficult to book an appointment. But I would still recommend them for their quality of their work.
